codeReview.summary: Feature successfully adds 4 comprehensive unit tests for glyph UV coordinate correctness in katla_ui/src/text/mod.rs. All tests validate VAL-ATLAS-003 requirements: UV coordinate normalization (0.0-1.0 range), UV bounds within atlas, padding to prevent bleeding, and edge cases with different atlas sizes. Tests are well-structured, follow TDD principles, and include clear assertions with descriptive messages.
